info.title: Dirty Pair OVA
info.synopsis: Gli esseri umani si sono sparpagliati per l'universo e hanno colonizzato migliaia sistemi solari. In questo periodo opera la World Welfare Work Agency (WWWA o 3WA per abbreviare), una società che lavora per i pianeti che fanno parte dell'Unione Galattica e che si occupa di risolvere qualsiasi tipo di caso, dalle indagini criminali, fino alla soluzione di problemi su scala planetaria. Lo svolgimento di questi incarichi viene affidato a degli agenti altamente specializzati chiamati Trouble Consultant (o TroCon). Se c'è un problema che nessuno può risolvere, la 3WA metterà a vostra disposizione due consulenti di prim'ordine: Kei e Yuri, due agenti della sezione investigativa che sono conosciute in tutto l'universo come le "Dirty Pair".

episodes.synopsis: Yuri is on a date, so when a job comes up Kei has to partner with Calico to intercept a counterfeiter.

tvdb.title: La rivolta molesta dei prigionieri
tvdb.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go to a facility located on a violent windstormed planet in an attempt to rescue a hardened warden from a bunch of prisoners who have overtaken the facility.

episodes.title: Il grande cannone
episodes.synopsis: Chief Gooley inspects the 3WA Weapons Lab, but Marcus has taken over and executed everyone. Gooley is taken hostage and the city is held to ransom with Marcus's God Cannon.

tmdb.title: Il grande cannone

tvdb.title: La festa di Halloween definitiva
tvdb.synopsis: The city celebrates Halloween with a large-scale cosplay, but the two girls can't celebrate as the 3WA has assigned them to capture a runaway android that resembles The Terminator. They must do so within the hour or something bad will happen. Meanwhile, some of the local criminals organize some heists

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The Lovely Angels are on their way to Karosu Prison, a heavily-armed fortress where the prisoners have started to riot. Someone needs to rescue the warden before he gets killed in the crossfire, and Kei and Yuri are just the ladies for the job!

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: The Lovely Angels are on their way to Karosu Prison, a heavily-armed fortress where the prisoners have started to riot. Someone needs to rescue the warden before he gets killed in the crossfire, and Kei and Yuri are just the ladies for the job!

tvdb.title: La sfida di Dio
tvdb.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go undercover on a world that is run by a planet-wide religion to investigate a corporate town site that was been devastated by a supposedly divine being. Yuri discovers the secret to how the deity is able to demonstrate his divine powers while Kei gets upset that the god keeps killing off her potential boyfriends.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: It's Halloween night, but instead of having fun, the Dirty Pair are stuck tracking down a Tactical Robot Weapon wandering the streets. What's worse, they only have an hour to find it before it goes haywire and starts destroying everything in its sights!

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: It's Halloween night, but instead of having fun, the Dirty Pair are stuck tracking down a Tactical Robot Weapon wandering the streets. What's worse, they only have an hour to find it before it goes haywire and starts destroying everything in its sights!

tvdb.title: Giochi di guerra uguale squadra che spara!
tvdb.synopsis: A military base has been taken over by a group of kids. Kei and Yuri are assigned the task of stopping the kids but without harming them as they are the sons and daughters of various high-ranking officials and leaders. The kids think this is all fun and games as they fight off the girls, but when they accidentally activate a super-powerful weapon, the military decides to authorize the use of deadly force. It will be up to Kei and Yuri to save the day.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Long ago, the Tarmians fled to a distant planet to live a quiet, religious life. But when their new god destroys a mining town and kills 300 people in the process, the Lovely Angels are sent in to investigate – and what they discover is a bloody mess!

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: Long ago, the Tarmians fled to a distant planet to live a quiet, religious life. But when their new god destroys a mining town and kills 300 people in the process, the Lovely Angels are sent in to investigate – and what they discover is a bloody mess!

tvdb.title: E poi nessuno ha scherzato
tvdb.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go to a space casino facility to recover one of the top 3WA agents who has fallen into a deep gambling habit. They find the guy at a high-stakes game called Meteor, which involves shooting meteor rocks around a planet and placing bets as to where it will land. Kei dresses up as a participant while Yuri searches the facility for clues as to how the game is rigged.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The Dimensional Vibration Gun is powerful enough to rip the universe apart and it's fallen into the hands of a bunch of snot-nosed kids! The Lovely Angels have to bring this little war game to an end, before the real-life army comes in with guns blazing!

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: The Dimensional Vibration Gun is powerful enough to rip the universe apart and it's fallen into the hands of a bunch of snot-nosed kids! The Lovely Angels have to bring this little war game to an end, before the real-life army comes in with guns blazing!

tvdb.title: Panico da matrimonio a sorpresa sulla spiaggia
tvdb.synopsis: Kei and Yuri visit an island whose prosperity is built mainly upon a family's counterfeiting operation. Yuri poses as an archeology student but is befriended by a handsome guy, while Kei gets to apply her skills in another not so romantic job. Yuri almost gets into trouble when she is caught snooping around on the church grounds, but the guy bails her out, and they fall in love, and suddenly they're getting married! The 3WA gang is flown in for the wedding, but Kei is still suspicious, and so are the family's members.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: One of the 3WA's best agents, Li Shu Ryu, has become a gambling addict on the casino station Shangri-La. The Dirty Pair are sent to bring him back to his senses.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: One of the 3WA's best agents, Li Shu Ryu, has become a gambling addict on the casino station Shangri-La. The Dirty Pair are sent to bring him back to his senses.

tvdb.title: La rivincita della ragazza muscolosa
tvdb.synopsis: Kei and Yuri go into the underworld of cage fighting to track down a former 3WA trainee named Sandra who is linked to a performance enhancing drug called Hustle (Hard Muscle) that's been sweeping the sport.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The Lovely Angels are on beautiful Sargilco Island! But they're not just there to lounge around in swimsuits – they're on the trail of the shady Casteno family. The two go undercover, but is Yuri getting in a little too deep?

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: The Lovely Angels are on beautiful Sargilco Island! But they're not just there to lounge around in swimsuits – they're on the trail of the shady Casteno family. The two go undercover, but is Yuri getting in a little too deep?

tvdb.title: La bella addormentata
tvdb.synopsis: Some terrorists attack a space station. A man puts his daughter into a capsule to escape. Kei and Yuri find her escape pod but she hasn't aged a bit in twenty years because the capsule is a cold sleep one. As the only witness to the incident, the girl is put under the supervision of Kei and Yuri as they try to unravel her past and what she remembers from the incident. But not everyone is keen on having secrets revealed.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Sandra the Bully is a former 3WA trainee turned to a life of crime, and Kei and Yuri are sent in to shut down her steroid-pushing drug ring. But they'll have their hands full with Sandra, now that she has five times the attitude and ten times the muscle!

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: Sandra the Bully is a former 3WA trainee turned to a life of crime, and Kei and Yuri are sent in to shut down her steroid-pushing drug ring. But they'll have their hands full with Sandra, now that she has five times the attitude and ten times the muscle!

tvdb.title: Fermate la squadra dei macellai!
tvdb.synopsis: A longtime war is nearing its end when a squad of five red eyed soldiers disrupts the peace process, destroying everyone. Kei and Yuri go to a town to investigate, and after convincing the locals they aren't government officials, they manage to get a ride to the site where they find one of the five soldiers is injured, and learn the secret behind who's behind the operation.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Twenty years ago, famed Dr. Nea was murdered, but his killer was never found. Now the Lovely Angels have stumbled across a cold-sleep capsule, with Nea's daughter inside. They know that she's the key to solving the case – and unfortunately, so does the killer!

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: Twenty years ago, famed Dr. Nea was murdered, but his killer was never found. Now the Lovely Angels have stumbled across a cold-sleep capsule, with Nea's daughter inside. They know that she's the key to solving the case – and unfortunately, so does the killer!

tvdb.title: Noi siamo camioniste spaziali!
tvdb.synopsis: The space trucks from an independent shipping company have been attacked recently, and with the Universal Corporation taking over operations, many of the truckers are dejected. Kei and Yuri go undercover and join the trucking staff for the shipping company and travel with two truckers who are still willing to face adversity.
